admit_card.context: This is for general information for those candidates who applied for the post of Sectional Assistant advertised by the District Selection Committee, East Khasi Hills District, Shillong vide Advertisement No. DSC.127/DSC-EKH/ADVT/2024/64, dated 2nd September, 2025 that the Qualifying Paper on knowledge of Local Language (Khasi Language) Examination will be held on 2nd May, 2026. Candidates are advised to download the e-admit card from the website at https://rpa.meghalaya.gov.in/rpaonline / w.e.f. 24th April, 2026 onwards. No candidate will be allowed to enter the examination Centre(s) without the e-Admit Card and a valid ID Card. Candidates must mandatorily produce the hard copy of the e-admit card during the examination when asked for by the Examination functionaries. Candidates are requested to report at the examination Centre 1 (one) hour before the commencement of the examination. Entry Gates will be closed 30 minutes before the commencement of examination. The decision of the Office in this regard is Final. 24/04/2026 02/05/2026 View (259 KB)
